mainEntity.name: How does an energy audit help with planning an energy-efficient remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: An energy audit provides a comprehensive assessment of your home's energy performance, identifying areas of energy loss and inefficiency. It typically involves inspecting insulation, windows, doors, and HVAC systems, often using tools like thermal cameras and blower doors. The audit report helps prioritize which energy-efficient upgrades will offer the greatest return on investment and energy savings. As part of our service, we can help interpret audit findings to develop a targeted remodeling plan.
